sections.h2: Fresh-loan rates fell 105bp of the 125bp cut, high pass-through by Indian standards

chart.title: Borrowers got most of the 125bp cut because liquidity was engineered

sections.means: The post names the CRR cut, OMO purchases and forex swaps as the delivery mechanism that let the repo cut transmit.

sections.h2: The RBI's corridor is only 50bp wide, so the overnight rate signal is precise

sections.means: The corridor is only 50bp wide, and the Bank Rate moves automatically with the repo rather than as an independent lever.
